name: powdee-skills
description: Agent skills for design systems, performance, product motion and reels. Keep code, Storybook and Figma telling the same story about a component; find out where the time actually goes before optimising anything; turn a product into a code-built motion film, synced to its voice-over and rendered in 16:9 and 9:16; caption camera reels with kinetic typography timed to a supplied voice-over.
